gloss: to rest, to take a day off

definitions.explanation: To relax or take a break.

definitions.gloss: to be absent, to take time off
definitions.explanation: To not attend school or work.

examples.japanese: {少|すこ}し{休|やす}みましょう。
{今日|きょう}は{学校|がっこう}を{休|やす}みます。
examples.english: I'm taking the day off from school today.

examples.japanese: お{大事|だいじ}に。ゆっくり{休|やす}んでください。

notes: Related nouns: {休|やす}み (break, vacation), {休日|きゅうじつ} (holiday).
